finalResult.nextParagraphText: “On that note, there’s something we should also make clear,” Artemis said in a strict tone. “I naturally know of the other partners in your life, namely the succubus and the Runemaiden. From what I gathered, there could be mo—”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “What?” Artemis commented, shaking her head. “I never felt like the time was right, and one has to be careful when selecting a partner, especially when it comes to the firstborn.”
